map.📖 查看「绕口令随机抽题使用指南」: 📖 View the Tongue Twister Random Prompt Guide
map.📚 深度解析：绕口令随机抽题: 📚 Deep Dive: Random Tongue Twister Prompts
map.点击\"开始\"获取一条绕口令: Click "Start" to draw a tongue twister
map.挑战快速念出声: Challenge yourself to read it aloud quickly
map.本工具为纯前端在线工具，数据在浏览器本地处理、不上传服务器，依据对应领域标准与规: This is a pure front-end online tool. Data stays in your browser and is never uploaded. It draws from a built-in library; no audio, timer or scoring.
map.从内置 20 条绕口令中取 ⌊random × 库长⌋ 的索引，若与上一条相同且: Picks an index from a built-in library of 20 tongue twisters, re-rolling when it matches the previous item, then shows the line number and its hand-labelled difficulty. This page only displays random prompts and difficulty; it does not record audio, time you or score you.
map.播音、口才课前热身: Warm-up before broadcasting or public speaking classes
map.点「开始」或「下一条」从内置 20 条题库随机抽题，页面显示文本、条目序号与难度: Click Start or Next to draw from the 20 built-in prompts; the page shows the text, item number and difficulty label. Draws skip the previous item to avoid repeats. Reset returns to the initial prompt. This page does not record, time or score.
map.抽中「四是四，十是十，十四是十四，四十是四十。」并标注「简单」，计数器显示「第: Drawing "Four is four, ten is ten, fourteen is fourteen, forty is forty" shows difficulty "Easy" and the counter "Item 1 / Difficulty: Easy". Click Next for another line and the number and difficulty update. Difficulty is hand-labelled in the library across 4 levels (easy / medium / hard / hell), not computed from phonetic similarity.
map.能加自己的绕口令吗？: Can I add my own tongue twisters?
map.不能。当前只从内置 20 条题库随机抽取；可复制文本到别处自行练习。: No. It only draws from the 20 built-in items; copy the text elsewhere to practise.
map.会计时、录音或评分吗？: Does it time, record or score me?
map.不会。本页只做随机展示与难度标注，不含计时器、录音、语音识别或评分功能。: No. The page only displays random prompts and difficulty labels; it has no timer, recorder, speech recognition or scoring.
map.从内置 20 条绕口令中随机抽题，显示文本、条目序号与人工标注的难度（简单/中等: Draws a random tongue twister from a built-in library of 20, showing the text, item number and a hand-labelled difficulty (easy / medium / hard / hell). Click Start or Next to draw again without repeating the previous item. This page does not record audio, time you or score you.
map.内置 20 条绕口令，覆盖简单到地狱 4 档难度: A built-in library of 20 tongue twisters across 4 difficulty levels from easy to hell
map.随机抽题并避开上一条，避免连续重复: Random draws skip the previous item to avoid immediate repeats
map.纯前端运行，无需联网、不上传数据: Runs entirely in the front end with no network or upload
map.内置 20 条绕口令，难度为题库人工标注的 4 档（简单/中等/困难/地狱）: A built-in library of 20 tongue twisters with 4 hand-labelled difficulty levels (easy / medium / hard / hell)
map.不录音、不计时、不评分；抽题会避开上一条: No audio recording, timer or scoring; draws skip the previous item
map.在绕口令库中取 ⌊random × 库长⌋ 的索引，若与上一条相同且库长 > 1: Pick index ⌊random × list length⌋ from the tongue-twister list; if it equals the previous one and the list is longer than 1, pick again; show the nth entry (index + 1) and its difficulty level
map.随机抽题展示绕口令文本，点开始计时，读完点停止，记录用时；可重复抽题比较。难度按: A tongue twister is drawn at random and displayed; tap start to time, read it, tap stop, and the elapsed time is recorded; you can draw again to compare. Difficulty is graded by how similar the sounds and rhymes are.
map.抽中「四是四，十是十」短句，第一次 6.8 秒、第二次 5.1 秒，越练越快；换: Drawing the short line "four is four, ten is ten": 6.8 s the first time and 5.1 s the second, faster with practice; switching to the longer "red carp and green carp" takes 14.2 s the first time. Timing is local only and does not judge correctness.
map.当前为内置题库随机抽题；可复制文本自行练习，工具只负责计时与展示。: This currently draws randomly from the built-in question bank; you can copy the text and practice on your own — the tool only times and displays.
map.用浏览器 performance 计时，误差在毫秒级，满足练习用途。: It uses the browser performance timer, with millisecond-level error, which is enough for practice.
